name: Wewards, Inc.
summary: Wewards, Inc. develops a web-based platform that is accessible by mobile apps. The company’s platform enables consumers to purchase goods from merchants and earn rebates payable in the form of Bitcoin. It also provides online-hosted service games, and related extra content and services, as well as engages in the software licensing business. Wewards, Inc. was formerly known as Global Entertainment Clubs, Inc. and changed its name to Wewards, Inc. in January 2018. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
